castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.leading_para: The Castle of Caccamo is one of the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Standing on a sheer rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley as a millenary strategic bulwark.
castle.para_2: Every corner of this manor exudes charm and mystery: from the famous Conspiracy Hall, the scene of intrigues and pacts between medieval nobles, to the ancient prisons carved into the stone used by the Inquisition.
castle.para_3: Between history and legend, the spirit of Sister Felicia still protects the village today. The Castellana awaits you in chat to reveal every secret of this timeless place.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or would you rather listen to the ancient legends of the castle? Feel free to ask.

desktop.title: Monuments of the Borgo
desktop.castle_desc: Among the largest medieval castles in Sicily, dominating the San Leonardo valley. An 11th-century Norman fortress, it preserves prisons, historical halls, and fascinating legends.
desktop.annunziata_title: SS. Annunziata Church and San Benedetto della Badia
desktop.annunziata_desc: Two adjacent churches, symbols of Caccamo's devotion. L’Annunziata treasures baroque stuccos; la Badia preserves crypts and a wonderful majolica floor.
desktop.sangiorgio_desc: Among the oldest in the borgo, featuring a Gothic-Norman facade and highly valuable wooden statues, with the castle standing right behind it.
desktop.angeli_title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
desktop.angeli_desc: A small Franciscan church immersed in silence, featuring a marble altar and the remains of Blessed Giovanni, a sacred figure deeply loved by the citizens.
desktop.cappuccini_desc: Founded in the 16th century, it hosts a sober cloister and a historical library. Panoramic view over the valley.
desktop.chat_hint: Click on my cards to explore them with me! ✨
desktop.welcomemsg_churches: The Castellana: Welcome to the heart of Caccamo's sacredness, stranger. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of these living walls? Just ask me.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on bare rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and evocative inner halls that recall centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true masterpiece of Sicilian Baroque, the church is world-famous for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica tiles, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A visual art masterpiece suspended in time.
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 years or with Castle ticket on the same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Also known for its connection to the Dominican complex, this church preserves important testimonies of local devotion. Inside, you can admire fine architectural details and artworks that tell the central role of this site in the religious history of the borgo.
santamaria.hours: Accessible in the moments preceding the celebrations.

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo stands majestically on the scenic monumental square. Rich in sacred treasures, Sicilian school paintings, and fine sculptures, it represents the beating heart of Caccamo's faith and a landmark for the sacred architecture of the area.
sangiorgio.hours: Sundays and Holidays: 11:00 AM (in conjunction with the Holy Mass).

annunziata.title: Parrocchia SS. Annunziata
annunziata.description: Set within the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality felt inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract both visitors and faithful.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 (Weekday Masses at 18:00 | Holidays at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the Convent is deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the conventual structure, the area offers an authentic insight into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 Caccamo's Hidden Gems: The borgo is home to 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time hours and openings of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco and other scattered masterpieces.
